927→fun ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed<MarketType, DebtType>(
   928→    liquidation_params: &LiquidationParams,
   929→
   930→    obligation: &Obligation<MarketType>,
   931→
   932→    emode_group: &EModeGroup,
   933→
   934→    reserves: &GenericCoinTypeStorage<Reserve<MarketType>>,
   935→
   936→    coin_decimals_registry: &CoinDecimalsRegistry,
   937→    liquidator_repay_amount: u64,
   938→
   939→    x_oracle: &XOracle,
   940→
   941→    clock: &Clock,
   942→) {
   943→    // make sure that their obligation still healthy, so users aren't borrowing over their collateral
   944→    let (weighted_debts_value, debts_total_value) = debts_value_usd_for_liquidation(
   945→        emode_group,
   946→        reserves,
   947→        obligation,
   948→        coin_decimals_registry,
   949→        x_oracle,
   950→        clock,
   951→    );
   952→
   953→    let (collateral_weighted_value, collateral_total_value) = collaterals_usd_for_liquidation(
   954→        emode_group,
   955→        reserves,
   956→        obligation,
   957→        coin_decimals_registry,
   958→        x_oracle,
   959→        clock,
   960→    );
   961→
   962→    // triggering condition: 
   963→    // user_ltv > liquidation_ltv
   964→    if (liquidation_params.liquidation_ltv_threshold_override.is_some()) {
   965→        let liquidation_ltv = *liquidation_params.liquidation_ltv_threshold_override.borrow();
   966→        let user_ltv = weighted_debts_value.div(collateral_total_value);
   967→        assert!(
   968→            user_ltv.gt(liquidation_ltv),
   969→            error::liquidation_obligation_still_safe(),
   970→        );
   971→    } else {
   972→        // user_ltv = weighted_debts_value / collateral_total_value
   973→        // liquidation_ltv = collateral_weighted_value / collateral_total_value
   974→        // user_ltv > liquidation_ltv
   975→        //    weighted_debts_value / collateral_total_value > collateral_weighted_value / collateral_total_value
   976→        //    weighted_debts_value / collateral_weighted_value > liquidation_ltv_threshold
   977→        //    weighted_debts_value > collateral_weighted_value * liquidation_ltv_threshold
   978→        assert!(
   979→            weighted_debts_value.gt(collateral_weighted_value),
   980→            error::liquidation_obligation_still_safe(),
   981→        );
   982→    };
   983→
   984→    // Note that the close factor is enforce ONLY when the obligation is not close to bad debt
   985→    let bad_debt_close_factor_bypass_threshold = float::from_quotient(101, 100);
   986→    let bad_debt_threshold = bad_debt_close_factor_bypass_threshold.mul(debts_total_value);
   987→
   988→    if (collateral_total_value.le(bad_debt_threshold)) {
   989→        // This means the obligation is close to bad debt, allow close whatever is passed
   990→        // close factor effectively equals to 1.
   991→        return
   992→    };
   993→
   994→    let target_debt_type = type_name::with_defining_ids<DebtType>();
   995→
   996→    let debt_balance = obligation.debt(target_debt_type).unsafe_debt_amount();
   997→    let debt_value = coin_value(
   998→        get_price(x_oracle, target_debt_type, emode_group.get_oracle_base_token(), clock),
   999→        debt_balance,
  1000→        coin_decimals_registry.decimals(target_debt_type)
  1001→    )
  1002→        // this is tricky, because it is using ceiling, this mean if the debt value is say 9.8, the ceiling is 10
  1003→        .ceil();
  1004→
  1005→    // below min usd for close factor enforcement
  1006→    if (debt_value <= liquidation_params.close_factor_bypass_min_value) { return };
  1007→
  1008→    let max_debt_amount = debt_balance.mul(liquidation_params.close_factor);
  1009→    assert!(
  1010→        math::float::from(liquidator_repay_amount).le(max_debt_amount),
  1011→        error::liquidation_close_factor_exceeded(),
  1012→    );
  1013→}

  1030→// calculate the actual repay amount, actual liquidate amount, actual market amount
  1031→fun liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens<DebtType, CollateralType>(
  1032→    exchange_rate: Decimal,
  1033→    liquidation_incentive: Decimal,
  1034→    actual_repay_amount: u64,
  1035→
  1036→    oracle_base_token: x_oracle::x_oracle::BaseToken,
  1037→    x_oracle: &XOracle,
  1038→
  1039→    coin_registry: &CoinDecimalsRegistry,
  1040→    clock: &Clock,
  1041→): u64 {
  1042→    let debt_type = type_name::with_defining_ids<DebtType>();
  1043→    let collateral_type = type_name::with_defining_ids<CollateralType>();
  1044→
  1045→    let price_borrowed = get_spot_price(x_oracle, debt_type, oracle_base_token, clock);
  1046→    let price_collateral = get_spot_price(x_oracle, collateral_type, oracle_base_token, clock);
  1047→
  1048→    let actual_repay_amount = float::from(actual_repay_amount);
  1049→
  1050→    let debt_decimals = math::u64::pow10_u64(coin_registry.decimals(debt_type));
  1051→    let collateral_decimals = math::u64::pow10_u64(coin_registry.decimals(collateral_type));
  1052→
  1053→    /*
  1054→     * Get the exchange rate and calculate the number of collateral tokens to seize:
  1055→     *  seizeAmount = (actualRepayAmount + actualRepayAmount * liquidationIncentive) * priceBorrowed / priceCollateral
  1056→     *  seizeTokens = seizeAmount / exchangeRate
  1057→     */
  1058→    let incentivised_borrow = actual_repay_amount.add(actual_repay_amount.mul(
  1059→        liquidation_incentive,
  1060→    ));
  1061→    // ignoreing decimal calculation as they will be cancelled out
  1062→    let incentivised_borrow_usd = incentivised_borrow.mul(price_borrowed).div_u64(debt_decimals);
  1063→    let seize_collaterals = incentivised_borrow_usd.div(price_collateral).mul_u64(collateral_decimals);
  1064→
  1065→    let seize_ctokens = seize_collaterals.div(exchange_rate);
  1066→
  1067→    assert!(
  1068→        seize_ctokens.lt(float::from(std::u64::max_value!())),
  1069→        error::invariant_seize_tokens_crazy_big(),
  1070→    );
  1071→
  1072→    // only take the tecnnically possible amount
  1073→    seize_ctokens.floor()
  1074→}
